messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] billing-metering-heartbeat missing in eu-west-1 for ~3m — potential token-count underreporting. Pager severity: P2. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-heartbeat.md
sre-ella: saw it. dashboard shows emitter latency spike at ~03:12 UTC, then heartbeat stopped around 03:15.
eng-raj: checking emitter logs now, tailing prod-emitter stdout
eng-raj: ```
2026-03-21T03:12:13Z WARN emit/queue: enqueue-delay 1200ms
2026-03-21T03:15:01Z ERROR emit/worker: heartbeat lost, reconnect failed: timeout
2026-03-21T03:15:02Z INFO emitter: switching to backup route
```
billing-maya: customer-facing impact? Any overage flags firing yet?
sre-ella: early signs of late usage reports; some customers saw transient invoice preview spikes but no finalized charges.
support-lin: we just received two support tickets from EU customers seeing higher estimated usage in dashboard. Triage sent them to ops.
oncall-dan: I'm taking the pager. @sre-ella handoff: what have you tried so far?
sre-ella: scaled emitter pool, restarted emitter-3 in eu-west-1; restart is flapping on reconnect. Backups handling some traffic but backlog building.
eng-raj: hotfix attempt: bump socket timeout and disable aggressive backoff for reconnect on emitter group. Rolling to emitter-1/2 first.
eng-raj: ```bash
# quick patch
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/emitter EMIT_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS=12000
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/emitter
```
billing-maya: suggest temporary mute for automatic overage alerts to avoid customer panic while we investigate. Ops can flip the mute? @product-oliver
product-oliver: agree — mute makes sense for false-positive risk. @oncall-dan please coordinate and document.
oncall-dan: muting billing-overage webhook for eu-west-1 for 2h now. Documenting in incident board.
support-lin: note — keep internal monitoring alerts for SRE only; we still need ledger data for reconciliation.
sre-ella: confirmed mute applied. Internal ingestion continues to ledger for post-incident reconciliation.
eng-raj: emitter-2 accepted config and is catching up. emitter-3 still failing with TLS handshake errors; looking at cert rotation logs.
eng-raj: ```
openssl s_client -connect emitter-3.eu-west-1:443
# response: verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
# subject=/CN=host-emitter-3
# notAfter=2026-03-20T23:59:59Z
```
eng-raj: cert auto-rotation appears to have failed overnight for that host — host agent permission error. Starting host cert hotfix.
sre-ella: estimated timeline for recovery?
oncall-dan: if cert rotation applies cleanly, heartbeat should resume in ~10-15m; monitoring ledger delta in the meantime.
billing-maya: escalate to accounting if missing tokens persist >30m — prepare customer comms templates.
support-lin: drafting a cautious notice for #support-customer-notifs: "We saw delayed usage reporting in EU region between 03:12–03:30 UTC. Dashboard estimates may have shown temporary spikes; finalized billing currently unaffected. We'll update after reconciliation." Will hold until recon results.
product-oliver: prioritize notification templates for enterprise customers and those near SLAs / high spend.
sre-ella: mitigation checklist: 1) replace expired host cert on emitter-3 2) verify emitter reconnect & heartbeat 3) confirm backlog replay 4) run reconciliation to detect token loss 5) decide on credits if thresholds exceeded.
eng-raj: rotated cert on emitter-3 host at 03:28 UTC, emitter-3 rejoined; heartbeat logged again at 03:30.
eng-raj: ```
2026-03-21T03:30:12Z INFO emitter/worker: heartbeat restored, backlog=34k tokens drained
```
sre-ella: ledger shows ~34k tokens delayed but ultimately ingested. Preliminary quick-check shows no customer delta beyond noise.
billing-maya: run full reconciliation job and produce delta report. If any customer delta >0.5% or >$50, escalate to product & support for outreach.
eng-raj: launching reconciliation: /jobs/recon/token-delta --region eu-west-1 --window 03:00-03:40
sre-ella: I'll hand to night SRE in 30m — oncall-dan please include recon output and credit recommendations.
oncall-dan: will keep thread pinned. @sre-maria please take over at 04:00 UTC. I'll post summary + recon output.
sre-maria: acknowledging. Will monitor and follow up if delta triggers threshold.
eng-raj: recon finished: summary: 34,012 delayed tokens re-ingested across 12 customers; max per-customer delta = 1,102 tokens (~$3). No customer exceeds $50 or 0.5% threshold.
sre-ella: marking incident resolved. Closing pager and moving to postmortem. Root cause: expired host cert prevented emitter-3 TLS reconnect; cert rotation automation failed due to host agent permission error.
product-oliver: escalate to infra for cert rotation permissions fix and add proactive monitoring for cert expiry on emitter hosts.
eng-raj: filed INFRA-8743 with logs and proposed mitigation (retry + fallback cert pull + 72h expiry alert cron).
oncall-dan: unmuted billing alerts and restored customer-facing webhooks at 04:10 UTC. Timeline documented on the incident board. Thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] billing-metering-heartbeat missing in eu-west-1 — resolved after cert rotation. Incident duration ~00:58. Severity downgraded to post-incident review.
